scope: Publication editing of the renamed Japanese LuaLaTeX main manuscript: algebraic Abel submoduli and envelope torsor, geometric Ku residual morphism, full framed Artin completion, and point-data reconstruction. Current evidence, dependencies and open scope only; no archived drafts or work log.

Main Introduction: theorem assumptions, proof dependencies and literature comparison
proof_review.method: Separate proof readings with root integration and primary-source hypothesis checks. No concrete contradiction or unresolved gap was identified within the audited scope. This is not external peer review or an independent reproof of all inputs.
core_checks: Jacobian etale saturation, universal centers, weight-zero Hom bundle, rank-four torsor, arbitrary-coefficient full faithfulness and irreducibility/finite type.

All-Artin envelope flatness: CFT multiparameter naturality, Lowen affine localization comparison, Yekutieli Cor11.2 with moving commutative products, and the actual transformation between functors represented by the same complete ring.
Framed fpqc descent, Amitsur logarithm correction, section derivations and vanishing of ordinary 1-groupoid automorphism classes; no elimination of dg scalar pi2.
Finite-width Koszul torsion, central quotient coinduction, genuine A-bimodule duality, strict dg localization, two-sided Q localization and relative Serre trace under nonflat coefficient changes.
Formal Ku recognition, coefficient-perfect effectivity, noncircular enriched Serre comparison, Serre-stable thick generation, perfect-kernel finite presentation and Torelli descent.

Scheme-theoretic first-order point liftability, finite point decomposition, regular cubic cut, tensor-representative independence, reconstruction of the quadratic envelope and scaled hPi_F, Casimir space, Hesse obstruction and modular residue.
limits: Universal PBW and cyclic-Hessian sign calculations were retained as written inputs; not every term and every geometric fiber was independently rederived.
All-O Hom comparison was read at the needed steps; its entire upstream Veronese and finite-central input chain was not newly re-audited.

Foundational external formality, quantization and categorical deformation theorems were used after checking the relevant statements and hypotheses; their complete proofs were not independently re-proved.
Main A-D summarize proved-in-manuscript results. Generic smoothness, formal completion, algebraization and novelty have distinct scope.

static.limit: Static closure only, not mathematical proof audit.

content_preservation.remark_scope: Four of five original root remarks unchanged verbatim; one deictic next-section reference replaced by an explicit label.
